Name: Novaroma Season Icons
Author: JestingDart4369
Description: 3,846 icons for your keys in five seasonal colour themes (Default, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter), each in light, dark and burgundy: 1,923 with a tile background and 1,923 without any background (file names end in -clear, tag No background), for wallpapers and your own key backgrounds. 104 symbols for system, development, media, audio and study, plus 12 on/off pairs for smart-home toggles. Made with the help of AI (Claude by Anthropic) and reviewed by the author.
